'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
****At least 16 [[Palestinian]]s are killed and at least thirteen others are wounded in [[Israeli Air Force|Israeli]] [[airstrike]]s across the [[Gaza Strip]], including several houses in [[Gaza City]] and [[Nuseirat refugee camp]]. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 European floods]]
**[[2024 Central European floods]]
***Four people in [[Poland]], three in the [[Czech Republic]], and one in [[Romania]], are killed during massive [[flood]]s, bringing the death toll from the ongoing flood in [[Central Europe|Central]] and [[Eastern Europe]] to 16. [https://apnews.com/article/central-europe-floods-poland-czech-e9501517da041fda946454f875dc890c (AP)]
*[[2024 Portugal wildfires]]
**[[Portugal]] asks the [[European Union]] for help to fight large [[wildfire]]s in the [[North Region, Portugal|northern]] and [[Central Region, Portugal|central]] regions of the country. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/portugal-asks-europe-help-wildfires-rage-2024-09-16 (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2024 Kursk offensive]]
***The [[Government of Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Ukraine)|ministry of foreign affairs]] invites the [[United Nations]] and the [[Red Cross]] to join [[humanitarian]] efforts in [[Kursk Oblast]], [[Russia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-asks-un-icrc-join-humanitarian-effort-russias-kursk-region-2024-09-16/ (Reuters)] 
*[[Ukraine–United States relations]], [[United States and the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Government of Ukraine|Ukrainian officials]] publicly distance themselves from the [[Donald Trump]]-[[Trump International Golf Club shooting|involved shooting]] suspect and warn that Russia will use the situation for anti-[[Ukraine]] [[State propaganda in the Russian Federation|propaganda]], following reports of the suspect protesting for the [[Azov Brigade]] and regularly calling for international support and troops for Ukraine. [https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/ryan-routh-reported-suspect-trump-assassination-attempt-backed-ukraine-war-2024-09-16/ (Reuters)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/kremlin-alleged-trump-shooters-ukrainian-links-playing-with-fire-has-2024-09-16/ (Reuters 2)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Immigration to Germany]]
**[[Germany]] initiates rigorous temporary [[Border checkpoint|border checks]] at all of its borders in order to reduce [[irregular migration]], prompting criticism from some [[European Union]] member nations stating that the border checks contradict the EU's foundations of [[Schengen Area|free movement]] and solidarity. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/germanys-tighter-border-controls-take-effect-irking-neighbours-2024-09-16/ (Reuters)]
*[[Trump International Golf Club shooting]]
**[[Ryan Wesley Routh]] is [[criminal charge|charged]] with two gun-related crimes in [[Federal judiciary of the United States|federal court]] after being suspected of attempting to [[Assassination|assassinate]] former [[United States]] [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/trump-safe-after-new-assassination-attempt-thwarted-florida-golf-course-2024-09-16/ (Reuters)]
*Two [[Law enforcement in Benin|police officers]] are fatally shot in [[Alibori Department]], [[Benin]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/two-police-officers-killed-ambush-northern-benin-2024-09-16/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[North Korea]] announces that it will revise [[Constitution of North Korea|its constitution]] on October 7, with changes including the designation of [[South Korea]] as a separate country and its primary enemy. This comes after North Korea announced that it would no longer pursue peaceful [[Korean reunification]]. [https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20240916_11/ (NHK World Japan)]
